entities.summary: The European Academies Science Advisory Council (EASAC) is a regional association of National Academies of science. EASAC comprises 29 member institutions: the national science academies of the European Union (EU) Member States, Norway, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and the pan-European organisations Academia Europaea and ALLEA. EASAC was founded in June 2001 and since 1 January 2024 it is hosted by the Austrian Academy of Sciences in Vienna.
